$comment: Written by scripts/features/env_audit.py --write: the sites and the automatic classes. The class, note and followup of the other names and the followups are kept by hand. The script's docstring has the queries and the classes.

classes.debugOnly: Every code site is compiled only into DEBUG builds.
classes.benchOnly: Every code site is compiled only into DEBUG or CMUX_BENCH_HOOKS builds.
classes.testOnly: Every code site is test code.
classes.childEnv: Set, forwarded or removed for a child process; it does not change this process.
classes.devGated: Compiled into Release; read only behind a runtime DEV, tagged, bench or test check.
classes.releaseConfig: Changes Release behavior off the perf paths: paths, ids, endpoints, binaries, opt-outs.
classes.diagnostics: An opt-in measurement or diagnostics switch that Release honors: tracing, probes, thresholds (Chrome keeps these as documented switches, like --trace-startup).
classes.releasePerfPath: Changes Release behavior on a perf path; its follow-up makes it a feature or compiles it out.
classes.notEnv: Not an environment name: a prefix of a family of names, or message text.
classes.unclassified: Compiled into Release and not yet classified (MQ7).

p12-perf-process-105.title: Daemon holder mode -> feature terminalHolder (process both); the env names stay as override aliases

MQ7-01.title: Compile the daemon's Release-honored delay and slowdown seams under cfg(debug_assertions), or a cargo feature only the bench daemon build turns on, like the 30 CMUX_TUI_TEST_* seams that are already Debug-only

MQ7-02.title: Drop the env overrides of the terminal persistence mode and the scrollback memory budget from Release: the terminal.persistence.* and terminal.scrollback.* settings and the memoryScrollbackPressure feature own them; tests keep them under cfg(debug_assertions)

MQ7-03.title: Input journal -> feature inputJournal (perfPath; dev and tagged builds on, Release off), CMUX_NEXT_INPUT_JOURNAL kept as its override alias

MQ7-04.title: Compile CMUX_CEF_DEFER_EVENTS (the in-process host-mode rehearsal of p01 task 231) under DEBUG || CMUX_BENCH_HOOKS until host mode ships

MQ7-05.title: Warm machine connection pool bound -> feature warmMachineConnections with a warmLimit param (default 5, at least 2), as Chrome sizes its back/forward cache with a kBackForwardCache param (content/browser/renderer_host/back_forward_cache_impl.cc); CMUX_TUI_WARM_MACHINES kept as its override alias
